To determine if the sum of the odd numbers in the group (15, 5, 13, 7, 1) adds up to an even number, we first identify the odd numbers:

Odd numbers: 15, 5, 13, 7, 1

Now, we will add these odd numbers together:

15 + 5 + 13 + 7 + 1 = 41

Since 41 is an odd number, the statement "the odd numbers in this group add up to an even number" is False.

So the answer is:
False.
